workflow.name: LordGen Demo — Approval Decision
workflow.description: Task 3: the tokenized endpoint both the proposal email's buttons and the future website panel hit. Idempotent, checks 14-day expiry, records the decision, and on approval chains into the existing Approve + Handover workflows.
